title: A Morning Interview
text:
Maria is a young journalist. Today she interviews Ahmet, a chef from Istanbul. He says he cooks every morning at five o'clock. He likes to use fresh vegetables from the local market.

Ahmet says his favourite dish is soup. He also tells Maria that he wants to open a small restaurant next year. Maria writes everything in her notebook. At the end, she thanks him and leaves.

questions.text: What time does Ahmet cook every morning?
Why does Maria write everything in her notebook?
options: Because she wants to remember the interview accurately

questions.text: What can we infer about Ahmet's plans for the future?
options: He wants to open his own restaurant
He will move to another country tomorrow

vocabulary.definition: a person who writes news stories for newspapers, magazines or television
a conversation in which someone asks questions to get information from another person
recently picked, made or produced; not old
a small book with blank pages used for writing notes

paragraph_translations: Maria genç bir gazeteci. Bugün İstanbul'dan bir aşçı olan Ahmet ile röportaj yapıyor. Ahmet her sabah saat beşte yemek pişirdiğini söylüyor. Yerel pazardan gelen taze sebzeleri kullanmayı seviyor.
Ahmet en sevdiği yemeğin çorba olduğunu söylüyor. Ayrıca Maria'ya gelecek yıl küçük bir restoran açmak istediğini anlatıyor. Maria her şeyi not defterine yazıyor. Sonunda ona teşekkür edip ayrılıyor.
